title: keel memory files, version 1
description: The shape of the Markdown memory files kh checks (the memory builtin and kh check). The files are Markdown, not JSON: this schema describes the fields each one must carry, in the order shown by the examples.

plan.description: .agents/plans/<slug>.md, one per multi-step task; deleted when the task is closed.

Scope.description: a line: Scope: <glob>[, <glob>...]; files outside every active plan's Scope are reported by the scope builtin

Acceptance.description: the heading ## Acceptance followed by at least one checklist item, - [ ] or - [x]

progress.description: .agents/progress.md, one line per closed task; an optional first heading # Progress.

lesson.description: .agents/lessons.md, one entry per triaged lesson, starting with the heading ## YYYY-MM-DD <title>.

Destination.description: a line: Destination: where it lives now

forbidden.description: Never in versioned memory: absolute user paths, references to local evidence, secrets.
default: a token or private key (the redaction set)
